label: Stocky, cropped hair, forearm tattoo
prompt: A photorealistic still of a stocky paramedic in her early thirties, seen from above and slightly to one side, looking straight up into the lens as she reaches overhead for something on a shelf in the back of an ambulance. Her face is broad and round, with a heavy jaw, a flat freckled nose, small pale-lashed grey eyes, chapped lips and a faint red mark across the bridge of the nose where a mask has sat for too many hours. Her hair is cropped close to the skull in uneven sandy-brown clippers work, with a few grey strands at the temple. She wears a green paramedic jacket with a frayed collar over a creased green uniform shirt; her sleeve is pushed to the elbow and her raised forearm carries a faded blue-black tattoo of a swallow above a ribbon of illegible script, the ink blurred with age. Her shoulders are thick and slumped with tiredness. The camera is a fixed unmanned lens bolted high in the ceiling corner of the vehicle, so the picture is wide, slightly distorted at the edges, a little soft, washed-out and flat in colour, with fine night-time grain and slightly crushed shadows. The only light is one long cold fluorescent strip along the ceiling, which flattens her face and leaves pale glare on the steel cabinets, blue-grey rubber flooring, a folded red blanket, a stretcher with a scuffed mattress and a dented oxygen cylinder. The picture contains no words, numbers, symbols, borders or overlays of any kind, only the scene itself. Thanks.

label: Black British, braids up, tired smile
prompt: A photorealistic still of a Black British paramedic in her late twenties, looking up into the lens with a tired, crooked, kind smile while she stretches one arm up towards a high compartment inside an ambulance. Her face is oval with a high forehead, full cheeks, deep brown skin that shows a little shine on the nose and forehead, a small scar through her left eyebrow, slightly puffy lids, and a gap between her front teeth. Her long box braids are twisted up into a lopsided knot on top of her head, with a few loose strands stuck to her neck. She wears a dark green uniform jacket zipped halfway over a grey fleece, a lanyard with a clutch of keys, and blue nitrile gloves, one of them with a torn fingertip. The camera is a fixed, unattended lens up in the corner of the ceiling, looking down across the length of the cabin, so she is small in the frame, the angle is steep, and the colours are drained and compressed like an old webcam picture, with soft detail and mild noise. The only light is a single hard strip light overhead, giving her a pale glare on the forehead and deep shadow under the chin, with a little orange streetlamp glow leaking in through the frosted rear window. Around her are a battered grab bag, tangled blue tubing, a roll of paper towel and a tipped-over paper coffee cup on a bench. The picture contains no words, numbers, symbols, borders or overlays of any kind, only the scene itself. Thanks.

label: Tall, thin, dark circles, broken nose
prompt: A photorealistic still of a very tall, thin paramedic woman in her mid thirties, stooped under the low roof of an ambulance cabin, craning her head back to look up into the lens as she reaches up for a box on a high rack. Her face is long and narrow, with sunken cheeks, deep violet-brown hollows under pale hazel eyes, thin lips, a pointed chin and a nose that has clearly been broken: bent to the right at the bridge with a bump halfway down. Her skin is sallow and uneven with dry patches by the nostrils. Her mousy brown hair is pulled back in a thin, greasy ponytail, with flyaways falling across her brow. Her wrists stick out of sleeves that are too short on a faded green uniform shirt with a pen clipped to the pocket and a coffee stain on the hem, and her long hand is spread open as it reaches. The camera is a fixed, operator-less lens in a ceiling corner of the vehicle, looking down at her from above, so her height is squashed, the wide picture bends slightly at the edges, the colour is faded and grey-green, and the image is grainy and low in contrast, like footage that nobody expected to watch. The only light is one pale strip tube above her and a faint blue flicker from a monitor out of sight, which leaves her eye sockets in shadow. Around her are a stretcher with a crumpled sheet, a yellow sharps bin, a stack of clipboards and a muddy boot print on the floor. The picture contains no words, numbers, symbols, borders or overlays of any kind, only the scene itself. Thanks.
